body.purpose: Messages and the composer; Inter 14px, line-height 1.45, names and buttons 500. Measure bounded at 72ch on the text itself.

title.purpose: Instrument Serif Regular for pane titles (Channels, Members, # channel, Settings, dialog titles, the popover name); 26px in panes, 32px in settings.

label.purpose: JetBrains Mono, UPPERCASE 11.5px tracked, ash: section labels, timestamps, counts, ms, status bar.

code.purpose: JetBrains Mono on well; keys sky, numbers chrome dim, comments ash. Also file names and sizes.

materials.name: lift
materials.purpose: Hover and selected ground, paired with a 1px hairline inset and white text when selected. A flat tone, never a gradient.

materials.name: backdrop
materials.purpose: The modal dim: flat void at about 85% alpha. The only translucency in the system.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: The one soft black shadow, popovers and dialogs only. Everything else is flat with a hairline.

motion.name: instant
motion.purpose: State changes snap. Gaming wins: nothing eases a layout property or springs.

motion.name: no-infinite
motion.purpose: Nothing repaints on the idle path. The typing indicator blinks on a stepped timer only while someone types.

breakpoints.name: members-drop
breakpoints.purpose: Member list dropped by setting state, never a style override.

radii.name: card
radii.purpose: Stream tiles, attachment/picture/link cards, code blocks, popovers, dialogs, settings sections.

narrative.overview: FitCommunication is pure black glass with hairlines: a void ground, one lifted tone for what is selected or hovered, one-pixel borders, white for what matters and ash for the rest, and a single pale-chrome accent. Titles are set in a serif, measurements in a mono, everything else in a plain grotesque. It replaced The Sixteen-Color Evening Machine (PC-98) on 2026-10-20 because Rick was done with retro and the call controls and volume sliders were cluttered while screensharing. design/main-window.html and design/shots/ are older anti-references; design/redesign-b/ holds the B mockups. Product truth binds it: no network fetch, fonts bundled in the binary, gaming wins (no animation, no infinite motion), offline and reconnecting never alarm-colored.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only: void ground, hairline borders, no hard shadows, no dither, no horizon band
One accent, chrome; green, red, amber and sky are signals only
Selected is a lift ground, a 1px hairline inset and white text, never an inversion
Inter for everything, Instrument Serif for pane titles, JetBrains Mono for figures and labels
Radii on a ladder of 6, 10, 16 and full
Every volume has exactly one home, the per-person audio popover

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Chrome is the only accent. A second accent hue for an action or a state is a bug; green, red, amber and sky mark state and identity only.

rules.name: The Offline-Is-Not-Red Rule
rules.body: Offline is an iron unlit dot, connecting is amber. Red means LIVE, error, Leave, DND and pressed-off, never a missing peer.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Every color is a theme::c value. An inline hex, or a translucent blend other than the modal backdrop, is a bug.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Serif for pane titles, mono for figures and labels, Inter for the rest.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: One soft black shadow, popovers and dialogs only. No hard offset shadows, no glow.

rules.name: The One Home Rule
rules.body: Mic, deafen and DND live in the self panel; camera, share, Spotify and Leave in the call bar while joined; Watch on stream tiles; every volume slider in the per-person audio popover; Allow drawing in the share menu.

dos: Do take every color from theme::c; chrome is the only accent.
Do make selection a lift ground, a 1px hairline inset and white text.
Do give every volume exactly one home, the per-person audio popover.
Do keep mic and deafen in the self panel and the other call controls in the call bar while joined.
Do keep icons on the 24x24 stroke 1.5 round grid, colored by currentColor.
Do change state instantly; only the speaking ring and the typing indicator move, and neither loops while idle.
donts: Don't add a dither, a horizon band, a hard offset shadow, or an inversion as selection.
Don't add a second accent, or let red mean offline or reconnecting.
Don't run an infinite animation, ease a layout property or add a spring: gaming wins.
Don't put a slider, chip or button inline in a member row, or a call control in the channels column.
Don't fetch a font or any asset from the network; faces ship as bundled TTF inside the binary.
Don't derive values from design/main-window.html or design/shots/; they are anti-references.
